source.text: הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי־ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Give thanks to YHWH, for [he is] good, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: Give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] good, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} thanks, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: Thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good! His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] bon, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Remerciez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon ! Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana [{{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni] mwema, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwema; upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwema! Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, here the LORD's love for his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love", Readable "faithful love".

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: Every one of the 26 verses ends with the same words (ki le'olam chasdo), "for his loyal love [is] forever": the people's answer to each line. The refrain is rendered the same way in every verse at each level.

decisions.choice: a call heard throughout Israel's worship
decisions.reason: The opening line and the refrain are also 106:1, 107:1 and 118:1, and were sung at the ark's coming to Jerusalem (1 Chronicles 16:34), at the temple's dedication (2 Chronicles 7:3) and at the laying of the second temple's foundation (Ezra 3:11).

decisions.choice: a litany of God's acts
decisions.reason: The psalm gives thanks for creation (verses 4-9), the exodus (10-16), the gift of the land (17-22) and God's care now (23-25). Later Jewish tradition calls it the Great Hallel. It retells what 135:8-12 tells more briefly.

decisions.choice: Thank
decisions.reason: Readable says "thank" in the call that runs through the psalm (verses 1-3, 26).

decisions.choice: the refrain: "car son amour loyal [est] pour toujours" (Literal); "car son amour fidèle dure toujours" (Balanced); "Son amour fidèle dure toujours." (Readable)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets this refrain for Psalms 106, 107, 118 and 136, so that it reads the same wherever it comes. Readable makes it a sentence of its own, as the English Readable does; at the start of a sentence "Son" is capitalised either way, so it carries no setting there.

decisions.choice: "Remerciez" at Readable; "Rendez grâce" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "rendre grâce" for hodu; Readable uses the everyday word, as the English Readable says "Thank".

decisions.choice: The refrain: "kwa maana upendo wake usiokoma [ni] wa milele" (L); "kwa maana upendo wake usiokoma unadumu milele" (B); "Upendo wake usiokoma unadumu milele" as a sentence of its own (R)
alternatives: "kwa kuwa fadhili zake ni za milele"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew refrain has no verb: "for his loyal love [is] forever". Literal shows that with a bracket; Balanced and Readable say that it lasts ("unadumu"). The same words are used in all twenty-six verses, as the Hebrew repeats itself, and in the other psalms that have this refrain. "Mshukuruni" (give thanks, plural) is the Hebrew hodu.

source.text: ה֭וֹדוּ לֵֽאלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Give thanks to [the] God of the gods, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.B: Give thanks to the God of gods, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: Thank the God who is greater than all gods. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: Rendez grâce au Dieu des dieux, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.

fr.R: Remerciez le Dieu qui est plus grand que tous les dieux. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

decisions.choice: God of gods: the supreme God
decisions.reason: "God of gods" and "Lord of lords" (verse 3) are the Hebrew way of saying the highest God, the highest Lord, as in Deuteronomy 10:17.

decisions.choice: the God who is greater than all gods
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m1).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

decisions.reason: As in verse 2 (Deuteronomy 10:17). The word ('adon) is a title, master or lord, not the divine name.

decisions.choice: the Lord who rules over all lords
decisions.reason: Readable says what the idiom means (m1).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

source.text: לְעֹ֘שֵׂ֤ה נִפְלָא֣וֹת גְּדֹל֣וֹת לְבַדּ֑וֹ כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

decisions.choice: To the one who: the call to give thanks continues
decisions.reason: Verses 4-7, 10, 13, 16 and 17 begin "to the one who ...", carrying on the call of verses 1-3: give thanks to the one who did these things. Each line is followed by the people's refrain, so each verse is printed as a line of its own.

decisions.choice: who alone does wonders
decisions.reason: God alone does wonders (72:18; 86:10): the acts the psalm goes on to name.

decisions.choice: each line its own sentence
decisions.reason: Readable makes each line a sentence about what God did ("He alone does ..."), and the refrain a sentence of its own (m1).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

decisions.choice: the Sea of Reeds: the sea Israel crossed, known as the Red Sea
decisions.reason: The name (yam suf) means "sea of reeds". It is the sea of the crossing (Exodus 15:4, 22). The ancient Greek translation calls it the Red Sea, the name long used for it.

decisions.choice: cut into pieces: split in two
decisions.reason: The verb (gazar) is to cut, and the noun (gezarim) is the pieces: the sea was divided (Exodus 14:21). The same noun is used of the halves of the animals in God's covenant with Abraham (Genesis 15:17).

decisions.choice: the Red Sea
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the familiar name, as in Exodus; Literal translates the Hebrew name, "Sea of Reeds".

decisions.choice: each line its own sentence
decisions.reason: As in 136:4.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

decisions.choice: "la mer des Joncs" (Literal); "la mer Rouge" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name is "Sea of Reeds"; Literal translates it, and the other levels use the name the sea is known by, as the English does and as Exodus 15:4 does in French.

decisions.choice: "Bahari ya Matete" (Sea of Reeds) at Literal; "Bahari ya Shamu" (the Red Sea) at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The Hebrew name means "Sea of Reeds". Literal shows that, as the English Literal does; Balanced and Readable use the name Swahili readers know for the sea Israel crossed.

en.R: He pulled us away from our enemies. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.B: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous a arrachés à nos ennemis, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il nous a arrachés aux mains de nos ennemis. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: na akatunyakua kutoka kwa watesi wetu, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: na akatuokoa kwa nguvu kutoka mikononi mwa adui zetu, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Alituvuta mbali na adui zetu. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

decisions.choice: tore us away: rescued by force
decisions.reason: The verb (paraq) is to tear off or pull away, as prey from a beast's jaws (Lamentations 5:8).

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

source.text: נֹתֵ֣ן לֶ֭חֶם לְכָל־בָּשָׂ֑ר כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: giving food to all flesh, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: giving food to all flesh, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: who gives food to every living creature, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: He gives food to every living thing. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: donnant de la nourriture à toute chair, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: qui donne la nourriture à tout être vivant, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Il donne de la nourriture à tout ce qui vit. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: anayewapa chakula wote wenye mwili, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: anayempa chakula kila kiumbe hai, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Anampa chakula kila kiumbe hai. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

decisions.choice: all flesh: every living creature
decisions.reason: "All flesh" is every creature that lives, people and animals.

decisions.choice: God feeds all he has made
decisions.reason: The God who rescued Israel also feeds all his creatures every day (104:27-28; 145:15-16).

decisions.choice: who gives
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has a participle; Balanced makes it a clause.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.

source.text: ה֭וֹדוּ לְאֵ֣ל הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Give thanks to [the] God of the heavens, for to-forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: Give thanks to the God of the heavens, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: Give thanks to the God of heaven, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: Thank the God of heaven. His faithful love lasts forever.

fr.L: Rendez grâce au Dieu des cieux, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: Rendez grâce au Dieu du ciel, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Remerciez le Dieu du ciel. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Mshukuruni Mungu wa mbinguni, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Mshukuruni Mungu wa mbinguni, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Mshukuruni Mungu wa mbinguni. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

decisions.choice: the God of heaven: the God who rules from heaven
decisions.reason: This title ('El hashamayim) is found only here in the Psalms. The same title, with another word for God, is common in Ezra and Nehemiah (Ezra 1:2; Nehemiah 1:4). The psalm ends where it began, with the call to give thanks.

decisions.choice: the refrain: his loyal love lasts forever
decisions.reason: As in 136:1.
